title: hypothesis.critique_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs CriticAgent to critique the frozen HypothesisBank against the frozen ResearchSpec. As of the RankingJudgeAgent milestone (Task 4), this is published IN-STATE after ranking.ready and optionally carries ranking_report_ref so the critique is rank-informed.

hypothesis_bank_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen HypothesisBank object.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchSpec object.

ranking_report_ref.description: Optional opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the RankingJudgeAgent RankingReport that ranked the HypothesisBank's candidates; null/absent when no ranking is available.
